info.title: agentd — Advisory Agent Plane
info.description: agentd's own REST API: runs a person starts and follows, the Desk's Hinweise and waiting proposals, verdicts, erasure and the specialist inventory. The worklist, run views and case history under `/api/v1/oversight` are agentplane's operator surface, described by agentplane's own OpenAPI document.

get.description:
What is *running here*, as opposed to `/api/v1/agents/catalog`, which lists
everything compiled in whether activated or not.

Authorized, not merely authenticated: in a combined-role deployment the
activated set names which arm's specialists this process runs, which is
§§ 6a and 7a EnWG-relevant deployment detail rather than public capability
advertising, and a token is not a reason to be shown it. The Agent Cards
under `/.well-known/agents/{name}` stay open — a card is what an agent *is*,
and carries no endpoint credential.

get.summary: `GET /api/v1/agents/catalog` — every specialist compiled into this binary.
get.description:
Lists what is *available*, whether or not it is activated, so an operator can
see what `[bundled_agents] enable` accepts. The declared ceilings come from
each specialist's manifest, which is the authority on them.

Gated by the same verb as `/api/v1/agents`: the catalogue is the compiled
set, which in a role-scoped build is the deployment's Marktrolle.

200.description: Every specialist compiled into this binary, activated or not

post.summary: Destroy a case wrapping key and/or forget a memory subject.

409.description: This deployment holds no key ring

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/hinweise` — the open worklist rows the caller's roles may
answer, each filed under its Anker: the Desk's Hinweise. Read under the
verb the oversight worklist is.

200.description: The open worklist rows the caller's roles may answer, each under its Anker

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A retried request with the same key is answered with the runs it already admitted

202.description: The runs admitted, each with its journal key

404.description: No activated specialist has that name

422.description: No subscribing specialist can act on the request

429.description: No specialist could be admitted now; resend

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/runs/{run}/antwort` — a run's answer, sentence by sentence,
each with the call it cites and whether that call's output carries its
figures. Read under the verb the oversight run view is (`RUN_READ`); a run
a person started is read only by that person, a run nobody started by
anyone holding the verb.

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: The run id the admission answered

200.description: The run's answer, sentence by sentence, each with the call it cites

403.description: Cedar `api:run.read` refused, or the run is another person's

post.summary:
`POST /api/v1/runs/{run}/bewertung` — record whether an answer or a
Hinweis helped, or what became of a proposal, under the caller's own name. A later verdict by the same
person replaces theirs; the judged run is never changed. A Freigabe
proposal's fate is read off processd's decided entry; the `vorschlag` sent
here is kept only as the verdict's rationale (`Plane::bewerten`).

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: The run id the admission answered

requestBody.description: Exactly one of `hilfreich` (with an optional `begruendung`) or `vorschlag`

204.description: The verdict is recorded under the caller's name

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/runs/{run}/schritte` — the run's reads as they are journaled,
as Server-Sent Events, then its conclusion.
get.description:
`schritt` per settled tool call, then `antwort` — the [`Answer`] `GET
…/antwort` returns for the run, unchanged — or `abgebrochen` with who
stopped it, after which the stream ends. Each event's `id` is the journal
sequence of the record it is derived from, and a reconnect's
`Last-Event-ID` continues after it, so no step is missed or repeated.

Read from the journal, never from an in-process channel — woken by the
store's append hint, with a poll as the fallback — so any instance serves
it and it cannot disagree with history (agentplane `api::a2a_stream`).
Authorized exactly as the answer read is: `RUN_READ`, and a run a person
started only for that person.

[`Answer`]: crate::plane::Answer

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: The run id the admission answered

200.description: Server-Sent Events: `schritt` per settled tool call, then `antwort` or `abgebrochen`

403.description: Cedar `api:run.read` refused, or the run is another person's

422.description: `Last-Event-ID` repeated or not an id this stream sent

post.description:
agentplane's `request_cancel` with the person as operator: durable at once,
acted on before the run's next effect — the call in flight completes, and
no further model turn or tool call is made — after which the `schritte`
stream ends with `abgebrochen` and the answer read reports `cancelled`. `202`, because
the stop is recorded, not yet carried out. Only the starter stops a run
here; anyone else's stop is the oversight surface's `RUN_CANCEL`.

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: The run id the admission answered

requestBody.description: No body, or an empty object

202.description: The stop is recorded and acted on before the run's next effect

403.description: Cedar `api:run.start` refused, or the caller did not start this run

get.summary:
`GET /api/v1/vorschlaege?freigabe=<id>,…&disput=<id>,…&buchung=<key>,…` — each entry's
waiting proposal, under its kind: its run's answer (`running`, or
concluded with its checked `vorschlag`), or `null` where none was
admitted. Read under the verb a run's answer is; it never starts a run.

200.description: Each entry's waiting proposal per kind and id, `null` where none was admitted

422.description: More entries than one request reads

ApiError.description: The problem body every refusal answers with. Branch on `code`; `detail` is for the developer.

code.description: A stable English machine code (`limit_too_large`), where the refusal has one.

detail.description: What went wrong, for the developer.

error_id.description: On a 5xx: the id the service's log line carries; the cause is never in the body.

upstream.description: On a 502/503/504: the service this one called that failed.

ErasureRequest.description: Destroy a case's wrapping key, forget a memory subject, or both.

RunRequest.description:
What a person asks a run for. Every field is named: an unknown one is a
`422`, because a misspelt `agent` read as absent would start every
subscribing specialist instead of the one named.

agent.description: The specialist to run; absent, every one subscribed to `event_type`.

event_type.description: The event type the run answers (`manual` when absent).

input.description: The event's data, handed to the specialist as is.
